note: What a client sends to say where its view sits and which way it faces. It is the most frequent request a client makes.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: Which seat the view belongs to.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: Names this report. A server returns it unchanged, and a client sends the report again until one comes back. It counts up through a byte and begins again, and a client takes a returned value as newer only where it is fewer than 128 steps ahead of the last it accepted.
